producer.adaptation: Official result-selection, assertion-classification and digest algorithm with js-gradle-slot, cleared display variables and disabled CUDA, existing per-task isolation (no init script), Vite runner config loading, mandated ten-minute retries, and a retained TMPDIR shared clone checked for exact baseline production/build sources. Private copied npm executable links retain their relative targets. Raw run logs retained outside gates with content digests; temporary-index object writes isolated under TMPDIR because source common Git metadata is read-only.
